description:
The 'Profile adoption (windows-latest)' CI job (crates/jit build on windows-latest) has failed on the last several pushes to main. Four sites don't compile on stable Windows Rust:

- storage/control_plane.rs:3 - unconditional `use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt`.
- profile/package.rs:452 - unconditional `nix::libc::ELOOP/EMLINK/ENXIO`; the nix crate exposes no libc module off-Unix.
- storage/file_transaction.rs (ambient_metadata_identity) and storage/repository_state_store.rs (capability_dir_identity, std_metadata_identity) call std::os::windows::fs::MetadataExt::volume_serial_number()/file_index() directly, which need the nightly-only windows_by_handle feature (rust-lang/rust#63010) and cannot compile on stable.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p jit --lib` succeeds with no errors.
- [hard] REQ-02: The unix and non-unix/non-windows code paths for the touched functions are unchanged in behavior; existing unit tests for control_plane, profile::package, file_transaction, and repository_state_store continue to pass on Linux.
- [hard] REQ-03: The Windows identity fix preserves real volume-serial+file-index fidelity (no silent fallback to an always-None/always-erroring implementation).
title: Fix Windows compile: unix-only imports and nightly-only windows_by_handle usage
